title: Qualla compat — next 300 geographically distributed structures — verified completion ledger
policy: A source or import is not completion. Ready requires current image references, exact source/runtime/LOD bytes, inspected portable/shared/context captures, photographic fidelity and terrain/placement evidence. Next-1,000 work is excluded. Imagery must be public domain, match published Qualla media and original attribution, and have current bytes. Conflicting or incomplete records are excluded.
